trigger.name: OLT ZTE: Equipamento Inacessivel / Desligado (Sem resposta SNMP por 1h)
trigger.description: Nenhuma resposta SNMP foi recebida da OLT nos ultimos 60 minutos. Equipamento pode estar desligado ou com fibra de uplink rompida.

trigger.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.system.uptime)<600 or change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.system.uptime)<0
trigger.name: OLT ZTE: Equipamento Reiniciou (Uptime < 10m)
trigger.description: O equipamento reiniciou recentemente ou perdeu energia.

parameters.parameter: return parseInt(value) === 0 ? 2 : 1;

item_prototype.name: ONU Dedicada {#NETSTREAM.ONU_DESC}: Motivo da Ultima Queda

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.dedicado.rxpower[{#SNMPINDEX}])<=-28 and last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.dedicado.rxpower[{#SNMPINDEX}])>-40
trigger_prototype.name: ONU Dedicada {#NETSTREAM.ONU_DESC}: Sinal Optico Critico ({ITEM.LASTVALUE1})
trigger_prototype.description: Sinal optico da ONU dedicada extremamente baixo (< -28 dBm). Risco iminente de queda do link.

trigger_prototype.expression: (min(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.onu.status.[{#SNMPINDEX}],#3)=1 or min(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.onu.status.[{#SNMPINDEX}],#3)=2) and change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.onu.status.[{#SNMPINDEX}])<>0 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.onu.status.[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: ONU Dedicada {#NETSTREAM.ONU_DESC}: LOS / Perda de Sinal Optico

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.dedicado.lan.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])=2 and change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.dedicado.lan.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])<>0 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.dedicado.lan.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1 and last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.onu.status.[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1
trigger_prototype.name: ONU Dedicada {#NETSTREAM.ONU_DESC}: Cabo LAN Desconectado / Porta Ethernet DOWN
trigger_prototype.description: A ONU dedicada esta online na fibra, porem o cabo de rede RJ45 (LAN 1) que liga ao cliente esta desconectado ou DOWN.

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.dedicado.lan.speed[{#SNMPINDEX}])=100 and last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.dedicado.lan.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1
trigger_prototype.name: ONU Dedicada {#NETSTREAM.ONU_DESC}: LAN Negociando a 100 Mbps (Degradacao Cabo RJ45)
trigger_prototype.description: O cabo de rede do cliente dedicado negociou a 100 Mbps em vez de Gigabit (1000 Mbps). Verificar crimpagem, oxidacao de conector RJ45 ou porta do firewall.

item_prototype.name: ONU {#ONUID}: Motivo da ultima queda (Last Offline Reason)

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.onu.last_offline_reason[{#SNMPINDEX},{#ONUID}])=2
trigger_prototype.name: ONU {#ONUID} no slot {#SNMPINDEX}: Fibra optica rompida (LOS)

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.onu.phase_state[{#SNMPINDEX},{#ONUID}])=4
trigger_prototype.name: ONU {#ONUID} no slot {#SNMPINDEX}: Sem energia eletrica (Dying Gasp)

parameters.parameter: var a=JSON.parse(value); for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++){if(a[i].idx=="{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}") return a[i].auth;} return 0;

trigger_prototype.expression: (max(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.dg.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],900)-min(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.dg.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],900))>=8 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.dg.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_LABEL}: DyingGasp detectado (Energia)

trigger_prototype.expression: (max(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],900)-min(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],900))>=3 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.los.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_LABEL}: LOS detectado (Fibra)

trigger_prototype.expression: change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])<-{$GPON_DROP_MIN} and last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])>0 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_LABEL}: Queda parcial de ONUs

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])=0 and change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}])<>0 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.pon.calc.online.zte[{#NETSTREAM.PON_INDEX}],180)>1
trigger_prototype.name: PON {#NETSTREAM.PON_LABEL}: Queda total de ONUs

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.port.ifoperstatus.zte[{#SNMPINDEX}],#1)=2 and last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.port.ifoperstatus.zte[{#SNMPINDEX}],#2)=1 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.gpon.port.ifoperstatus.zte[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1

discovery_rule.name: NETSTREAM - Descoberta de Portas LAN / Uplink da OLT

trigger_prototype.expression: max(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],#3)=2 and change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])<>0 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.uplink.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Uplink {#IFNAME} ({#IFALIAS}): Link DOWN / Desconectado
trigger_prototype.description: A porta LAN/Uplink fisica da OLT caiu e permanece indisponivel.

trigger_prototype.expression: min(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.cpu[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>90
trigger_prototype.name: Placa {#SNMPINDEX} ({#CARDTYPE}): Uso de CPU elevado (>90% por 10m)

trigger_prototype.expression: min(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.mem[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>90
trigger_prototype.name: Placa {#SNMPINDEX} ({#CARDTYPE}): Uso de memoria RAM elevado (>90% por 10m)

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])=9 and change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])<>0 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Placa {#SNMPINDEX} ({#CARDTYPE}): Placa com defeito (Faulty)

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])=4 and change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])<>0 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1
trigger_prototype.name: Placa {#SNMPINDEX} ({#CARDTYPE}): Placa Desconectada / Offline

trigger_prototype.expression: last(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])=2 and change(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}])<>0 and count(/OLT ZTE - NETSTREAM DEV/netstream.zte.card.status[{#SNMPINDEX}],10m)>1
